title: Backtracking: permutations
summary: Enumerate orderings of distinct values by swapping a candidate into the next open slot. Undo each swap after exploring that branch.
triggers: generate all orderings of distinct items
fix a prefix and rearrange the remaining positions
prompts: List every possible batting order for a small team.
Generate all distinct orders in which a technician could visit a handful of different stops.
invariant: Slots before start form the fixed prefix and the suffix contains all remaining candidates.
mantra: Swap into place, explore, swap back.
pitfalls: Copy the completed arrangement because the working list is reused.

anchors.name: Permutations
anchors.trick: Choose a different remaining element at each depth.

mutations.explanation: Leaves one branch’s choices in the array when the next branch starts.
